payload.title: FUN-provider-sessions: public-process proof for Provider Sessions after vertical completion

Do not invent Provider Sessions HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters or reopen CUT-PSES-PROV / Providers adapter groups

payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Provider Sessions as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Provider Sessions protocol surfaces (HTTP-PSES already terminal), and edges.Edges effect replacement. Validate and, only where needed, extend focused functional proofs under tests/functional/provider_sessions so association and Codex/Cursor/HTTP details remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Provider Sessions behavior without importing provider_sessions/internal or deleted provider_sessions/service from outside the owner and without inventing pkg/root or pkg/wire test-only composition helpers. Confirm no production peer reaches Provider Sessions through transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages. Do not invent additional Provider Sessions protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Do not reopen CUT-PSES-PROV. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
